title: How Sense is unlocking real-time energy insights for every home
summary: Sense is on a mission to make homes smarter and more energy aware. Their software, embedded in next-generation smart meters, translates raw electrical signals into real-time insights, helping consumers understand exactly how energy is being used in their home, device by device. Now, with the launch of EV Analytics, Sense is bringing that intelligence to one of the fastest-growing parts of the home: electric vehicles. EV Analytics helps households understand charging behavior, optimize costs, and prepare for the future of smart charging. To make it possible, Sense partnered with Enode.
